relations.reading: The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.

relations.title: Secuencia JUBAP
relations.reading: The network example suggests a JUBAP leverage point in the funding and transfer rule itself: make the contributing node sustainable so the wider service can work.

relations.title: Nivel y frontera del resultado
relations.reading: The historical Chicontepec account helps separate local capability formation from programme-level and territorial outcomes; improvement at one level cannot stand in for the others.

relations.reading: The second-order HID programme can extend the incentive question by testing how contribution recognition and withdrawal rights change feasible collective outcomes.
